body:
Feedback on 1.15.0:
- Expense lists: move the Expenses | Balances pill and the settings gear onto the
  list title's line, right-aligned, dropping to the next line when the title is too
  long. Drop the pill's checkmark and some padding so it stays small. Both clients.
- Web: the round Add button sits at the window's right edge; it belongs inside the
  list layout, right-aligned with the right border of the list entries.
- Web: the overview still has the old "+ New list" button at the top; it becomes
  the same bottom-right button (the app already does this).
title: layout follow-ups: a smaller pill, Add inside the list's width, no top New list button
